rules.statement: In construing a contract, the court should focus on the substance of the transaction rather than just the form and terminology used.
rules.supporting_quote: "In construing a contract the Court will look at what the contract really is and not at what the parties say it is. What the Court has to consider is not the mere name given to it but the substance of the transaction and decide what it would in truth and in fact amount to on a consideration of all the facts relating to it."
